original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚疾控中心召开首次事件管理会议协调埃博拉应对
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚疾病控制与预防中心（NCDC）周三召开首次事件管理会议，以协调埃博拉疫情应对工作。此前尼日利亚已正式宣布埃博拉疫情暴发。NCDC表示正在敲定事件行动计划，团队已在现场开展病例管理、加强监测、接触者追踪和感染预防控制等工作。该消息由尼日利亚通讯社报道，目前为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚疾控中心召开首次事件管理会议协调埃博拉应对
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: NCDC convenes first incident management meeting to coordinate Ebola response

key_facts.fact: 会议是在尼日利亚正式宣布埃博拉疫情暴发后召开的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: convened its first Incident Management Meeting following Nigeria's official declaration of an Ebola outbreak to coordinate response efforts

key_facts.fact: NCDC表示正在敲定事件行动计划以指导协调干预
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The NCDC said the Incident Action Plan was being finalised to guide coordinated interventions and strengthen the country's response to the outbreak

key_facts.fact: NCDC团队已在现场开展病例管理并加强监测、接触者追踪和感染预防控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: its teams were already on the ground conducting case management and other response activities, with emphasis on enhanced surveillance, contact tracing and infection prevention and control
